name: Bodyguard
note:
<JS Pre-Damage as Target>
var kilin = $gameParty.battleMembers().find(function(m) {
  return m._actorId === 5;
});
if (kilin && kilin.isAlive()) {
  kilin.gainHp(-value);
  kilin.startDamagePopup();
  kilin.gainTp(Math.floor(value / 20));
  kilin._bodyguardIntercept = true;
  value = 0;
}
</JS Pre-Damage as Target>

name: Muralha Pessoal

name: Muralha Contra Impacto (aliados)
note:
<JS Pre-Damage as Target>
var kilin = $gameParty.battleMembers().find(function(m) {
  return m._actorId === 5;
});
if (kilin && kilin.isAlive()) {
  var redirectedDmg = Math.floor(value * 0.50);
  kilin.gainHp(-redirectedDmg);
  kilin.gainTp(Math.floor(redirectedDmg / 20));
  kilin._bodyguardIntercept = true;
  value = 0;
}
</JS Pre-Damage as Target>
